title: Fixed-scalar pro-etale finite models imply etale finite models
statement: Under the hypotheses of finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding, ProFiniteModels.fixedModels for the finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction of F implies the displayed etale-local property P(F).

source.place: Tag 099Y, descent of finite constant pro-etale charts to etale charts

proof.text: Transport the fixedModels hypothesis to the AsSmall site with ProFiniteModels.fixedModels_asSmall. Over the Noetherian lifted finite ring, finite modules are finitely presented. Apply coefficientFpLocalSystem_etaleCover. The proved comparison_coversTop_reflect helper reflects its cover to the etale model site, and continuous AsSmall.down transports that cover to concrete etale objects. Undo the slice equivalence on each chart and apply the proved fixedModelSchemeIso helper to obtain a constant model on its scheme.

For each finite module M over ULift B, restrict along the inverse lifted-ring equivalence. Module.Finite.of_surjective transfers finite generation. Module.Finite.small supplies a carrier in universe t; Shrink.linearEquiv and ULift give an explicit linear isomorphism from the required lifted small B-module to M. This is the fully proved private small_finite_module lemma; no witness is chosen from an unproved existence statement.

Use the proved sliceCoordinates equivalence and sliceCoordinatesSquare from the slice-model transport module. The unit of pbcScalarAdjunction is invertible since scalar restriction along phi is an equivalence. Compose its inverse with koszulConstantScalarIso and constantLocalizationIso to identify the fixed coordinates of the actual completedAdicChange constant model with the constant lifted module. Transport the small-model linear isomorphism through constantSheaf and reflect the resulting isomorphism through the fully faithful sliceCoordinates functor. This proves the private ringed_model_of_fixed lemma, without a derived-category argument.

Compose each etale chart over V.left with V.hom, giving an X-etale object and an arrow to V. The etale covering criterion follows from joint surjectivity of the original family. Generate its sieve and pull back along any g:W to V. Every member factors through one original chart. The proved fixedRestrictionComp and fixedConstantPullbackIso helpers restrict its constant model to that member. Apply ringed_model_of_fixed to obtain the displayed small finite completed-adic model. All constructions work also for the empty cover and the zero ring.

theorem finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding_reverse
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ) (V : X.Etale)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ)).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    ProFiniteModels.fixedModels (ProEt.topology V.left) (ULift.{t + 1} B)
      ((finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).obj F) → P F
